cohort_scope: fixed named ETFs, not general sector-universe discovery
price_basis: total_return close, explicitly bound adjustment vintage; no fallback stores

formation_protocol.decision_cutoff: 09:00 America/New_York on next verified cash session
formation_protocol.eligible_nodes: all fixed-cohort nodes with finite incumbent washout_w>0 and qualified complete warmup; if any required node source fails, whole-date unqualified
formation_protocol.source_exclusions: frozen common to both arms before candidate output; retain all scheduled denominators and reasons
formation_protocol.opportunity_bearing: at least one eligible node at the scheduled formation

candidate_selection.failure_disposition: any runtime/output/refusal failure on otherwise source-qualified opportunity-bearing formation => entire candidate numerical result REFUSED; never complete-case deletion

reference_comparison.baseline: mean native loss over all eligible nodes on same formation
reference_comparison.candidate: mean native loss over trusted top-K nodes
reference_comparison.estimand: equal-date mean of mean single-entry 25-session adverse losses, conditional on qualified complete original two-position opportunity blocks in the fixed nine-ETF cohort; no general-universe or all-calendar-date claim
reference_comparison.direction: long-only simulated reference, no position-sizing or trading authority

numerical_ruler.version: exact pinned source SHA and subsequent reviewed input seam
numerical_ruler.entry: next cash-session close after trigger bar
numerical_ruler.primary_loss: max(0,-native_MAE): 25-session single-entry post-entry adverse excursion, including four sessions after the 21-session reference exit; not realized trade drawdown or portfolio MAE
numerical_ruler.missing_price_return: refuse, never use incumbent fillna(0) on unqualified inputs
numerical_ruler.labels: trusted evaluator only; mature full25-session horizon + source receipt; single declared basis/vintage

cost_policy.primary_loss: gross native excursion with separately disclosed identical normalized entry cost
cost_policy.secondary_exit_return: native21-session exit return minus20bps round trip
cost_policy.meaning: predeclared conservative research assumption, not measured implementation cost
cost_policy.secondary_status: descriptive only; no additional confirmatory claim or champion selection

development.historical_class: reconstructed unless original availability+vintage receipts qualify; model contamination disclosed
development.label_cutoff: 2017-12-29; exclude from tuning any formation whose full 25-session labels are not mature and received by that cutoff

selection.preknown_market_periods: historical exploratory evidence, never prospective confirmation
selection.label_cutoff: 2023-12-29; use only full 25-session labels mature and received by that fixed cutoff; no outcome-dependent extension

post_selection_2024_to_freeze: do not treat as fresh holdout; kept out of v1 selection/generation feedback unless existing Vault owner separately admits a counted diagnostic

prospective.start: first scheduled qualified source capture strictly after accepted freeze
prospective.formal_confirmation: only after predeclared matured sample+assumption+source gates; no repeated interim significance peeks
prospective.natural_time_lower_bound: 39 gaps times 26 cash sessions = 1014 sessions between the first and fortieth triggers, plus about 26 sessions to entry and label maturity: approximately 1040 total, over four trading years at perfect coverage
prospective.champion_selector: Among protocol-qualified eligible variants, largest independently accepted lower confidence bound; exact tie resolved by lexicographic canonical candidate_id; no champion when none eligible. Freeze before feedback.
prospective.final_read_owner: Existing Research Factory forward/experiment owner, exact admitted operation and authoritative record must be identified before prospective activation; this document creates no watcher.

budget.runtime_spend: root approved envelope only; no new grant
budget.controls_charge: known-answer synthetic and deliberately leaky pilot code variants consume root total4 unless incumbent owner qualifies separate preexisting non-generation fixtures; no free pilot search

inference.calendar_cluster_unit: one complete formation date; ETF rows never independent trials
inference.inference_block: 2 fixed formation positions by original scheduled calendar index (52-session span); no compression or adjacency reassignment after source exclusions
inference.eligibility: proposed family-adjusted one-sided lower bound on paired mean reduction exceeds0.005; exact interval coverage independently qualified first; source/coverage/power/assumption gates satisfied; advisory only
inference.power_claim: planning approximation only, no achieved power claim without data-qualified clustered estimate
inference.dependence_or_nonstationarity: inference unqualified if declared block adequacy weak-stationarity assumption cannot be supported; no post-outcome block tuning to obtain PASS
inference.dsr: not required primary MAE-loss inference; optional predeclared return-series diagnostic only
inference.pbo_cpcv: predeclared optional diagnostic or required only if trusted protocol specifies; never substitutes for sources/multiplicity/temporal proof
inference.block_qualification: both scheduled formation positions must be source-qualified and opportunity-bearing; retain denominator and reasons for excluded/no-opportunity positions; candidate failures refuse entire numerical result
inference.coverage_claim: NOT_PROVEN; Bonferroni family envelope does not establish valid marginal/bootstrap interval coverage
inference.variance_qualification: Raw block SD is not a long-run SD unless variance adequacy and dependence assumptions are qualified before outcomes; overlapping 63/260-session warmup persists across 26/52-session formation/block spans. No inferential PASS until the exact procedure, missingness, variance and marginal interval coverage are independently qualified.

actual_unqualified_facts: exact eligible row/cohort counts and completeness
development block variance and required final N
actual reserved window seals/peeks and label-release owner
